title: Every bus and tram in London in 24 hours
description:
Every bus and tram running in London on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside Greater London. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Bus, Superloop, Night bus and Tram, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 6,544 vehicles at 3:55 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
